label: Darcy–Weisbach
text: EN.O.A2.1.2 Darcy–Weisbach head loss h_f = f (L/D) V²/2g, where f is the Darcy (Moody) friction factor, four times the Fanning factor.

warrant.standard: Validation against experiment with stated uncertainty (ASME V&V 20)
